opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva. PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva for non-Genetics Society meetings and virtual meetings. Supervisors providing support letters must be current members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants to assist with travel and accommodation costs to attend Genetics Society or Special Interest Group (SIG) meetings, travel, accommodation and registration cost at other (non-Genetics Society) meetings, and registration costs for (non-Genetics Society) virtual meetings.

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.
